text.en:
Today you learn to say whose thing it is.
This is my coat.
It means: the coat is mine.
This coat is mine.
It means the same, in a different way.

Before the thing: my, your, her, his, our, their.
My gloves are wet.
Your scarf is on the chair.
Without the thing: mine, yours, hers, ours, theirs.
These seats are ours.

You will pick the right little word.
Is the thing named right after it? Use my, your, his.
Was the thing named before? Use mine, yours, hers.
This key is hers.
These tickets are theirs.
